subject: math
question: 求 $y'' + 2y' - 3y = f(x)$ 满足 $y(0) = 0, y'(0) = 1$ 的特解，其中 $f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 1, & x \geqslant 0 \\ e^x, & x < 0 \end{cases}$ .
answer: $$y = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - \frac {7}{3 6} e ^ {- 3 x} + \frac {3}{4} e ^ {x} - \frac {1}{3} x - \frac {5}{9}, & x \ge$$

steps.text: 分析 由于自由项 $f(x)$ 是一个分段函数，所以求解方程时要分段进行.

$$
y = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} C _ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 3 x} + C _ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} - \frac {1}{3} x - \frac {5}{9}, & x \geqslant 0, \\ C _ {3} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 3 x} + C _ {4} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \frac {1}{4} x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}, & x <   0. \end{array} \right.
$$
在 $x = 0$ 处 $y$ 连续可微，且满足初值条件，则有 $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} y(+0) = y(-0) = 0 \\ y_{-}'(0) = y_{+}'(0) = 1 \end{array} \right.$ . 即

$$
y = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - \frac {7}{3 6} e ^ {- 3 x} + \frac {3}{4} e ^ {x} - \frac {1}{3} x - \frac {5}{9}, & x \geqslant 0, \\ - \frac {3}{1 6} e ^ {- 3 x} + \frac {3}{1 6} e ^ {x} + \frac {1}{4} x e ^ {x}, & x <   0. \end{array} \right.
$$

solution.final_answer: $$y = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - \frac {7}{3 6} e ^ {- 3 x} + \frac {3}{4} e ^ {x} - \frac {1}{3} x - \frac {5}{9}, & x \ge$$
